messages:
mike: Heads-up — urgent hotfix for embeddings-service. 2.3.1 -> 2.3.2. Memory leak on small pods causing OOMs in eu-west1. Need expedited deploy during the 03:00-04:30 UTC change window. No DB migrations. Rollback plan: pin traffic to 2.3.0 and drain affected pods. Can we get quick ops approvals?

deploybot: CI ✅  Staging canaries: pass
Proposed rollout: canary 5% -> 50% -> 100% with 2m health checks between steps. Manual approval required to fast-track. Logs: https://ci.internal/embeds/1809998888

ops-oncall: I'm on. +1 for expedite if canary starts at 5% and we watch memory and restart counts for 10m. Can we have a kill-switch?

mike: Kill-switch is `/deploy rollback embeddings-service --to 2.3.0 --immediate` (ops-runbook page linked). We'll also have a firewall-based traffic pin if deploy bot can't immediate rollback.

tess: Any release-note text I should copy into the console? I can also notify CS if we go full rollout.

shayla: Draft release note: "embeddings-service: fix memory leak causing OOM on under-provisioned pods. Backwards-compatible, no migrations. Rollout limited to EU edge first."

anika: +1 from product for expedited. Please tag me if we need messaging to customers. :thumbsup:

maria: seeing a small latency blip in eu-west1 from unrelated experiment (0.7% tail). Recommend holding at canary if we see >1% error or >200ms p95 increase after first step.

mike: Agreed. We'll hold for 10m on canary and abort on thresholds maria listed. Thresholds recorded in the runbook.

deploybot: Manual approval requested. To approve run: `/deploy approve 1809998888 --fasttrack --by mike`

mike: `/deploy approve 1809998888 --fasttrack`

deploybot: Approval received from mike. Starting canary rollout — 5% traffic -> 2.3.2. Monitoring 10m. Canaries: ingress-latency, pod-restarts, 5xx-rate.

deploybot: Canary step complete: 0 errors, no restarts, p95 +18ms (within threshold). Advancing to 50%.

maria: hold — I'm seeing a 3.2% spike in 5xxs for eu-west1-edge at 03:19 UTC. Not sure if related.

tess: I'm +1 to pause until we confirm signal source. We should not advance to 100% until cleared.

mike: Pause acknowledged. Rolling back the canary now while we investigate. If rollback fails, use pin.

deploybot: Initiating rollback of affected canary groups to 2.3.0. Commands run: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embeddings-service embeddings=embeds:2.3.0` and traffic pin executed.

deploybot: Rollback complete. Current stable pinned to 2.3.0. All health checks green.

maria: Confirmed — 5xxs returning to baseline. Looks like unrelated edge experiment collision.

mike: Thanks everyone. We're aborting fasttrack for now. I'll open a short incident note and schedule a retry in the next maintenance window after we isolate the experiment. Tess — can you post the release note draft to the console but mark as "deferred"? Shayla/note in the changelog: include rollback details.

shayla: Will do — posting now and tagging CS.

anika: Thanks — ping me when we have a clean green canary and we can coordinate customer comms.

mike: Postmortem + short ops checklist will follow. Good catch, maria. :heart:
